note.question: What determines omnichannel retail refers to a seamless integration of an e-commerce channel and a network of brick-and-mortar stores?
note.overview: Omnichannel retail refers to a seamless integration of an e-commerce channel and a network of brick-and-mortar stores. An example is cross-channel fulfillment, which allows a store to fulfill online orders in any location. Another is price transparency, which allows customers to compare the online price with store prices.
